restoration_procedure: Verify the designated source_folder contains exactly page-001.jpg through page-344.jpg and no other regular files; compare each sha256 with contracts/source-catalog.json before copying.

Copy each original_file byte-for-byte to the matching staging_file. Do not rename, overwrite, edit, or re-render any designated original; staging is the only place where a future name adaptation may occur, and this revision needs none.

Run the repository helper ingest from the verified staging directory into a fresh ignored project/T3/pages/T3 cache. The helper must accept only page-NNN.jpg files and must record actual cache hashes and dimensions.
Recompute sha256, staged_sha256, and cache_sha256 for every entry and require all three to match the pinned source hash and the corresponding inventory digest before using the cache downstream.
